author: Last_Winchester
quote: The game itself does not justify abandoning GTA V and is a fail attempt at catching close to a decade of hype. The gameplay is glitchy. The story is lackluster with repetitive quests and gameplay to drag your tired and bored mind across the pavement until you get to the end, believe me you will be happy it ended. My opinion is my opinion, as you may love it but overall to me this game just caused a great fear of the possible dumpster fire Red Dead Redemption 3 could be.
